repos_data.description: Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first AI team for your desktop: a Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, with projects, scheduled automations and connectors. Free app for macOS & Windows; built-in models or your own keys.

AI画布：免费、轻量的本地 AI 创作工具，面向 AI短剧、图像与视频创作。集成无限画布、ComfyUI 工作流、分镜、图像/视频生成、视频剪辑与资产管理，支持 Agent、MCP 和 Blender。Free, lightweight, local-first AI canvas for AI short drama, creative workflows, storyboarding and video editing.

git-wt is a Zsh-native plugin that provides a safe, predictable and completion-first workflow for managing Git worktrees in your shell. It offers explicit commands to create, switch, list and remove feature worktrees, with first-class tab completion and a minimal, deterministic command set.
